activity_summary: You went through the door. She kept the cloth in her arms. You said the morning was paper and the yard was later, and you did not name either. She told you to come back hungry.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in Went out the street door

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

facets.activity: Got the cloak and left for the Theatre

quotes.text: And come back hungry, not interesting.
